name: search
description: The `search` verb — turning a room over by hand. A single-shot skill check (deliberately NOT a posture loop; `scavenge` in plugins/scavenging already owns that shape) whose results come entirely from registered providers. The plugin itself knows how to roll and how to fail; it knows nothing about what can be found. Anything that wants to be findable calls registerSearchProvider() and decides its own bar off the roll margin.
